topic.readerProblem: An SEO or marketing lead who already knows Ahrefs wants to know what Brand Radar tracks, what it really costs in checks, and where it is weak before paying for it.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits what AI engines say about a brand; the page explains where a platform index and metered prompt checks fit versus a one-off audit, and uses AEOeye's recommendation-benchmark finding that rank matters, with its caveat.

assessment: The page explains Brand Radar's two modes (AI Visibility Index and Custom Prompts), the four metrics, platform coverage and refresh cadence, and builds a price table plus a check-math example from Ahrefs' own rules (30 checks per prompt per month, 8 checks per Claude update). It flags Ahrefs' inconsistent index-size figures (405M, 448M, 475M), the Grok data pause and the beta-to-chargeable note. It rests on Ahrefs' public pages and Google's Search Console help only, uses one AEOeye benchmark figure with its n and self-selection caveat, and makes no hands-on, accuracy or outcome claims.

sources.supports: Two modes (AI Visibility Index, Custom Prompts), metric definitions, 448M+ prompts, $199/mo index, $699 for all models, custom prompts from $50/mo, Claude 8 checks per update, index limited for brands with little search demand, free quota in paid plans.

405+ million prompts, data collection from People Also Ask via web version of each chatbot without personalization, chatbot data updated once a month, Claude via API (Sonnet 4.6 with web search) custom prompts only, Grok data temporarily paused, prices and custom-prompt tiers, beta indexes free then chargeable, plan-requirements table, no cap on brands/domains, API/MCP/Looker Studio.

Lite $129, Standard $249, Advanced $449 per month with 5/10/20 tracked AI prompts; Brand Radar from $199/mo over 475M+ prompts; custom prompt packages $50/$100/$250 with 2,500/7,000/25,000 checks and overage rates; annual billing saves up to 17%; 5 prompts on 1 platform = 150 checks a month.
Free checker, no signup, five platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Overviews), limited preview with top 5 results per section.
Search Console generative AI performance report shows impressions in AI Overviews and AI Mode; rolled out to all websites worldwide as of August 31, 2026.
Semrush AI Visibility Base $99/mo per domain billed annually with 25 custom prompts.
